description: This file defines the 'GrainLifecycle' class within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It manages grain lifecycle stages and migration participants, extending lifecycle functionality with migration support.

classes.name: GrainLifecycle
classes.description: Handles lifecycle management for grains, including stage name resolution and migration participant management.

methods.name: GetMigrationParticipants
methods.description: Returns the collection of registered grain migration participants.

methods.name: AddMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Adds a new grain migration participant to the list.

methods.name: RemoveMigrationParticipant
methods.description: Removes a specified grain migration participant from the list.

methods.name: GetStageName
methods.description: Returns the name of a lifecycle stage based on its integer identifier.
